name: ai-job-application-copilot

scripts.lint:commits: commitlint --from HEAD~3 --to HEAD || commitlint --from HEAD~1 --to HEAD
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:backend -- --coverage && npm run test:frontend -- --coverage
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:functions
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build:frontend && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:functions: npm run build:functions && firebase deploy --only functions
